footnote_text: These shares represent restricted stock units granted under the John B. Sanfilippo & Son, Inc. 2023 Omnibus Incentive Plan. Each restricted stock unit represents the contingent right to receive, upon vesting of the unit, one share of John B. Sanfilippo & Son, Inc. common stock. Subject to certain conditions, these units are scheduled to vest on November 10, 2029. These units, once vested, will generally be eligible to be paid in an equivalent number of shares of the Company's common stock on November 10, 2029.
